description: This file defines the DatabaseConnectionWrapper class, which wraps database connection handling, error detection, and messaging for the OrangeHRM installer. It includes methods for establishing connections, error handling, and extracting error messages related to database connectivity issues.

classes.name: DatabaseConnectionWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class managing database connection handling, error detection, and messaging within the OrangeHRM installer context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with a database connection and an optional exception representing an error.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Returns true if there is an error present, indicated by the stored exception.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates an appropriate error message based on the stored exception and specific error codes.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the stored exception object, if any.

methods.name: establishConnection
methods.description: Static method to establish a database connection via a callback, performing system checks and error handling.
